content.short: Langarnia is an educational RPG on Cardano that makes learning new languages interactive and fun for players.
content.description: Langarnia is a fantasy-themed role-playing game (RPG) specifically designed to revolutionize language learning through interactive gameplay. Built on the Cardano blockchain, the project combines a 'Narnia-like' fantasy world with a comprehensive educational curriculum. Players gain access to the game via lifetime NFT license keys and progress by communicating with NPCs and completing adventures in their target foreign language. By blending gaming mechanics with academic study, Langarnia creates an immersive environment that keeps students motivated and curious throughout their journey.
content.meta: Langarnia is a Cardano-based educational RPG that gamifies foreign language learning with NFTs. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
